commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for marking tasks as done

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for unmarking completed tasks

commitResults.messageTitle: Use an enum for chatbot command types
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize command keywords in CommandType and route input through an exhaustive switch so command handling no longer depends on repeated free-form strings. Preserve exact matching for no-argument commands and add regression coverage for unexpected list and bye arguments.

Integrate automatic task saving and startup loading, including portable file handling, corrupted-data recovery, and restart-focused UI coverage.

Integrate LocalDate parsing, readable date formatting, persisted date validation, and comprehensive date-focused UI coverage.
